pages.text: $(bold)Base Extract$() is a reagent required by the $(bold)Sequencer$() machine to create specific strain extracts. You need one Base Extract per Sequencer operation.$(br)$(br)It is crafted in the crafting table and is consumed each time you sequence a strain extract.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Tip:$() Keep a supply of Base Extract ready before running the Synthesizer → Sequencer chain. You will need one per strain extract you want to create.
